rules.name: trash-day-folder
rules.why: the trash keeps removed songs under a folder named for the day

rules.name: run-time-ticks
rules.why: .NET ticks of a run-time instant (2025 on), as in activity ids, journal keys and state files; replaced by a fixed number so a JSON body stays JSON

rules.name: playlist-cover-art-hash

rules.name: radio-outcome-multipliers
rules.why: the multipliers fade with the age of each play, to the nanosecond
